owner_rules.rule: This is a new app, no relation to the old sutra-ui. Its design is the J2 prototype's design.
There is ONE global org chart; tasks reuse, add to or rearrange it on need. Never one chart per workflow.
Everything in the J2 prototype is present in the app.
Each of the five functions is an agentic graph node with the Sutra plugin's goal, task, context and work-atom behaviour inside.
Model calls go through a connector layer using the Claude and Codex connectors.
Decide autonomously; document each decision in the design and in the architecture diagram.
Keep merging locally; never push, never open PRs.

steps.step: 1 Chat agent reads the chart; does the requirement fit the org
steps.gap: run end to end by tests/e2e (GAP-E2E); a real model reading the digest is the live smoke (GAP-LIVE, run on the owner's say-so)

steps.step: 2 For a new department or workflow the agent references the models library
steps.gap: prompt content is tested in the e2e scenario; a model that reads the schema is the live smoke (GAP-LIVE)

steps.step: 3 claude cli + python models build structured workflows and a visual graph
steps.gap: run through the real router over the fake claude and codex (GAP-E2E); the real CLIs are the live smoke (GAP-LIVE)
the browser walk against the real app runs with SUTRA_BROWSER=1 (GAP-E2E-UI)

steps.step: 5 Each node is linked to its chat session
steps.gap: the e2e scenario resolves every node's chat session from the real graph (GAP-E2E)

steps.step: 6 The graph updates dynamically from agent interaction
steps.gap: the live chain, engine to browser, is run by GAP-E2E and GAP-E2E-UI

steps.step: 7 Each department and division is linked to its chat
